backend/main.mo: Actor managing user profiles and product data with access control, supporting creation, default population, and retrieval of products and metadata.
backend/migration.mo: Defines migration from old product definitions to new ones by adding missing fields and returning an updated actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records linking features to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides brief summaries of many frontend files, describing their roles in product editing, PDF/ZIP generation, onboarding, and UI components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining theme variables for light and dark modes with base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document loading jsPDF, JSZip, and the main React entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component handling authentication, profile setup, onboarding, view switching, and product bundle workflow.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity authentication state with accessible labels and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for first‑time profile creation allowing users to enter and save their name before proceeding.
frontend/src/components/errors/GlobalErr: React error boundary that catches runtime errors and displays a styled fallback screen with reload and optional dev details.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: UI component showing tabbed instructions for using the app and selling exported products on platforms like Gumroad and Etsy.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: Export interface that lists generated bundles and provides PDF, ZIP, and master ZIP downloads with error handling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main layout wrapper with header navigation, authentication-aware actions, and buttons for previewing, exporting, and viewing instructions.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Modal that displays onboarding guidance using the ExportInstructions component with a dismiss button.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Panel that previews a generated PDF using an iframe or shows a message prompting generation.
frontend/src/components/preview/UnifiedP: Unified preview page showing all products with cover images, expandable descriptions, and PDF previews per bundle.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Renders a scrollable preview of files that will be included in a product ZIP based on its templates, checklists, and prompts.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Provides a full editor UI for modifying a product’s fields, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists, and triggers content generation.
Manages the full product editing workflow including draft persistence, backend syncing, validation, and bundle generation.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Store: Displays a product card with cover image, truncated description, and an edit button for storefront listings.
Shows a storefront-style grid of default products with navigation back to the editor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendProducts.ts: Fetches three predefined products from the backend using the actor and exposes loading and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication state and helpers using Internet Identity, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Tracks whether onboarding instructions have been seen and manages opening/closing onboarding UI with localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/usePopulateDefaultPro: Provides React Query hooks to check admin status and trigger default product population, invalidating product queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines hooks for fetching and saving the caller’s user profile via the backend actor with React Query cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light/dark themes, plus utility styles including workspace accent and touch scrolling.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Maps product IDs to cover image paths and provides helpers to fetch covers as blobs.
frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts: Exports a detailed list of default product entries with modules, prompts, templates, and checklists.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Implements utilities to download blobs and files by creating temporary object URLs.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates slugified, date-based filenames for products, including PDF and ZIP naming helpers.
frontend/src/lib/generation/formatGenera: Formats generation-related errors into user-friendly messages and logs detailed diagnostic info.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Generates bundles for all products sequentially, emitting optional progress updates.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Builds a product bundle by loading its cover, generating a PDF, and packaging a ZIP with structured error handling.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generationEr: Defines a typed GenerationError class capturing step context and root causes during bundle generation.
frontend/src/lib/generation/productDataE: Defines a ProductDataValidationError describing missing fields and context for invalid product data.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Manages loading, saving, and resetting versioned product drafts in localStorage with error handling.
Generates a product PDF using jsPDF, validating fields, normalizing text, and optionally adding a cover image and module pages.
frontend/src/lib/pdf/jspdfClient.ts: Provides a safe wrapper for accessing jsPDF from the browser-loaded CDN and creating documents.
frontend/src/lib/products/mapBackendProd: Maps backend product definitions to frontend entries, filling missing fields with defaults.
frontend/src/lib/validation/productValid: Validates required product fields and aggregates validation results across multiple products.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Builds a master ZIP containing individual product ZIPs and a consolidated README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Builds a ZIP for a single product including its PDF, cover image, templates, checklists, prompts, and README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/jszipClient.ts: Provides a safe wrapper for accessing JSZip from the browser-loaded CDN and creating ZIP archives.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Generates standardized README sections with usage instructions and marketplace upload guides.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Renders the React app root with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines ProductEntry, ProductModule, and GeneratedBundle data structures used throughout the app.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, container settings, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project state, including issues with missing product fields for PDF generation and pending feature requests to align backend product data with frontend needs.
